economics.label: 05 / THE STORE MODEL
economics.title: A cup. A day. A business.
economics.body: Move the inputs. See exactly what changes.
economics.assumptions: ASSUMPTION A02. 30 trading days/month; ingredients and packaging 56 ₴/cup; transaction fees 3%; rent 55 000 ₴; fully loaded staffing 210 000 ₴; other fixed costs 120 000 ₴/month; initial funding 2 100 000 ₴; illustrative FX 42 ₴/$, not a live exchange rate. 56 ₴ remains an earlier planning assumption, not the calculated cost of the new recipes. The 500/700 ml formats need separate costing.
economics.explanation: Gross margin excludes labor and occupancy. Contribution deducts direct cost and transaction fees. EBITDA deducts rent, staffing and other fixed costs. Payback divides initial funding by steady-state EBITDA: it excludes ramp-up, financing, tax, depreciation, replacement capex and working-capital changes. EBITDA is not distributable cash.
economics.benchmark: Category articles describe roughly 65–80% cup gross margins and $30k–$150k startup formats; these are broad editorial benchmarks, not validated Ukrainian budgets.
economics.zeroNote: Gross margin is undefined at a zero ticket. Setting every slider to zero still leaves other fixed costs of 120,000 ₴ per month.

catalogue.title:
Tea every day.
Fruit in its season.
catalogue.intro: A menu built around the taste of tea: clear foundations, shared preparations and fruit worth waiting for.
catalogue.coreNote: Six recipes take priority for launch. Tea, milk and cheese foam form the foundation; tapioca complements just two drinks.
catalogue.seasonalNote: Four recipes to follow the seasons. Introduced when fruit quality and supply are consistent, rather than all at once.
catalogue.note: Our opening menu is in development. Volumes include ice. Prices will follow tasting and recipe costing.
catalogue.sweetness: Sweetness is calibrated for each recipe. Even without added syrup, fruit, jam, milk, foam or pearls may still contribute sugar.
catalogue.method: Green tea connects lemon and the fruit collection; oolong connects everyday tea and seasonal pairings. Shared dairy preparations, foam and tapioca reduce separate processes.
catalogue.design: A place for tea and conversation. Pale stone, soft light and greenery shape the mood of our future space.
catalogue.allergy: Ingredients are preliminary. Confirm allergens and possible cross-contact before ordering.
catalogue.cost: 56 ₴ remains an earlier planning assumption, not the calculated cost of the new recipes. The 500/700 ml formats need separate costing.
